414:t_020:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A failed unit endangers the entire design philosophy and value of human-support circuits.」

414:t_020:30.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I recognize the immediate shutdown and disposal of $$ストライカー#pilot$$ as my highest priority.」

414:t_020:31.en:
$$レド$$
「So to you, it's a disgrace to the family.」

414:t_020:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're here because you made your own decision. If you've escaped its leadership and control, settle this once and for all.」

414:t_020:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. You're here now as a human. Next, do what you must as a soldier... as a warrior.」

414:t_020:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「In this unexpected environment, you have always thought and judged correctly as a human. As a result, I, too, have maintained normal functionality.」

414:t_020:38.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I disagree. Both of you are malfunctioning.」

414:t_020:39.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's defeat it, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. That's our duty.」

414:t_020:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$! If you get in $$レド$$'s way, we'll take you on!」

414:t_020:42.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My mission is to annihilate you. Let's begin.」

414:t_020:43.en:
$n
「$$レド$$! Leave the others to us!」

414:t_020:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「You take down that overthinking fool!」

414:t_020:45.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm counting on you too, lady pirate! At this point, we can use your help!」

414:t_020:46.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Young man, when you address me, 'great pirate' is the proper term.」

414:t_020:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm counting on you, great pirate sis!」

414:t_020:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! We'll take $$ストライカー#pilot$$ down ourselves!」

414:t_020:49.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I will carry out the mission with all my power.」

414:t_021:0.en:
$$レド$$
「How can it be that strong without a pilot?!」

414:t_021:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー#pilot$$ analyzed Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$'s piloting skills and optimized its autonomous movement program. Its mobility exceeds mine by 47%.」

414:t_021:3.en:
$$レド$$
(How could I have believed in something so hollow and empty? I thought all I needed was a great cause to worship, rely on, and obey...)

414:t_021:4.en:
$$レド$$
(Even when it was a mechanical fake, I couldn't tell the difference at all.)

414:t_021:5.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Submission is the path to peace. Recognize this, Ensign $$レド$$.」

414:t_021:6.en:
$$レド$$
(This is the great cause he wanted?! We fought for this, and even spent our comrades' lives on it...!)

414:t_021:7.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$! $$マキシマイズ$$! Begin $$ニューロプラスパワード$$!」

414:t_021:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot authorize that. Without support, the pilot's machine fusion is suicide.」

414:t_021:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「That decision is outside acceptable limits.」

414:t_021:11.en:
$$レド$$
「It's all right, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

414:t_022:0.en:
$$レド$$
「It's a disgrace to the family... Just like you said earlier.」

414:t_022:1.en:
$$レド$$
「It's a monster born of humanity, which couldn't stop hating each other even after abandoning its homeworld.」

414:t_022:2.en:
$$レド$$
「You and I were born and raised in the same world as it. We're the same kind. We have no place on this revived planet, and no way home anymore.」

414:t_022:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Then it's all right. If I can take it down with me, I'll have no regrets.」

414:t_022:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request confirmation of your final intent. Ensign $$レド$$, do you desire your own death?」

414:t_022:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I... I know how to die, but I don't know how to live.」

414:t_022:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Yet there was someone... who would search for a way to live together with me.」

414:t_022:7.en:
$$レド$$
「I wanted to see her again... I wanted... to hear her voice more.」

414:t_023:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$'s psychological aptitude does not meet the requirements for a soldier. Therefore, I revoke your military status effective immediately.」

414:t_023:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Noncombatants cannot be permitted in the cockpit. Leave this unit immediately.」

414:t_024:0.en:
$$レド$$
「What are you doing, $$チェインバー#pilot$$?!」

414:t_024:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am a Pilot Support and Enlightenment System.」

414:t_024:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I fulfill my purpose by enabling you to achieve greater results.」

414:t_024:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「All of this sky and sea will bring you possibilities.」

414:t_024:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Survive. Explore. I expect the greatest results from your life.」

414:t_024:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「In that case, $$レド$$ still needs you.」

414:t_025:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「It isn't over yet, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. $$レド$$ needs your strength to go on living.」

414:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「He may not qualify as a soldier, but he's still immature as a human, too.」

414:t_025:3.en:
$n
「He can be a pilot even if he isn't a soldier. Your support and enlightenment aren't finished yet.」

414:t_025:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「You've got some nerve, you wet-behind-the-ears brats!」

414:t_025:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit trying to act cool. Hurry up and put that fledgling in your black baby carriage.」

414:t_026:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$... I said I didn't know how to live.」

414:t_026:1.en:
$$レド$$
「If I don't know, I can search for it... with $$エイミー$$ and everyone else.」

414:t_026:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Your logic is sound.」

414:t_026:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Let me decide the timing for $$マキシマイズ$$.」

414:t_026:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I will follow your judgment.」

414:t_027:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「A Support and Enlightenment System has no authority to reject its pilot.」

414:t_027:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed a transformation in my system as well, just as in yours.」

414:t_027:2.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Unit number K6821, you have abandoned even the first principle of human-support circuits.」

414:t_027:3.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your malfunction is evident. Initialize and reboot immediately. This is my final warning.」

414:t_027:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I will reply to your final warning.」

414:t_027:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Drop dead, you tin bastard!」

414:t_028:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am... a Human Support and Enlightenment Regulation System... My disappearance is humanity's loss...」

414:t_029:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「So this is as far as we go. $$アンタレス１$$ is retreating.」

414:t_031:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll stop you, for $$ランカ$$'s sake, too!」

414:t_031:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Can the likes of you do that?」
